title: Interstellar Visitors
subtitle: From other stars

description:
Episode 45 of a daily journey through the universe. ☄️
Interstellar visitors: 'Oumuamua in 2017, the strange cigar- or pancake-shaped object that sped up as it left; comet Borisov in 2019; and 3I/ATLAS in 2025, the fastest yet and possibly older than our solar system.

➡️ Tomorrow, Episode 46: Next stop, Tabby's star. The star that dimmed so strangely, some wondered about alien megastructures.
Start from Episode 1 "Leaving Earth" on the channel.
Follow so you don't miss a stop. A new episode every day.

Narration: AI voice

#space #oumuamua #astronomy #shorts #science

segments.text: Episode forty-five. Next stop... visitors from other stars.
Everything in our solar system was born around our Sun. But in twenty seventeen, a telescope in Hawaii spotted something that wasn't.
segments.headline: Not from here

segments.text: It was moving far too fast to be trapped by the Sun's gravity. It came from another star system. Astronomers named it Oumuamua, Hawaiian for a messenger from afar.
segments.headline: Oumuamua

segments.text: It was strange. Its brightness changed so much that it may be long like a cigar, or flat like a pancake.
Stranger still, it sped up slightly as it left, without a visible tail. Most scientists think escaping gas pushed it. A few wondered if it was artificial.
segments.headline: It sped up

segments.text: Two years later, an amateur astronomer named Gennadiy Borisov found the second visitor: a comet from another star, with a glowing tail.
segments.headline: Comet Borisov, 2019

segments.text: Then in July twenty twenty-five, a telescope in Chile found the third: 3I ATLAS.
segments.headline: 3I/ATLAS, 2025

segments.text: It raced in at about fifty-eight kilometers per second. The fastest interstellar visitor yet.
It may come from an older part of our galaxy, which means this comet could be older than our solar system.
segments.headline: Older than the Sun?

segments.text: New telescopes like the Vera Rubin Observatory may find many more. Pieces of other worlds, delivered to our door.
segments.headline: More are coming

segments.text: Tomorrow, a star that dims in a way no one could explain. Next stop: Tabby's star. Follow, so you don't miss episode forty-six.
